summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, furnishing a press release from its majority-owned subsidiary NeuroThera Labs Inc. (TSXV: NTLX) announcing a technological milestone: the successful demonstration of an end-to-end hybrid quantum-classical workflow for clinical data analytics. No financial terms, transactions, or corporate actions are disclosed. The filing is routine progress reporting on a subsidiary's platform development. This is not a special situation; it is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer on operating developments.
